Remark
[diameter of nontrivial spherical quotients]

Source: petersen:page-0286 ↗ thm:pet-ch6-cartan-fixed-point 1. ch6:6.7.22Use an analogue of section 2 to show a closed manifold of constant curvature $1$ is either the standard sphere or has diameter $\le \pi /2$; generalize to show a closed manifold with $\sec \ge 1$ is either simply connected or has diameter $\le \pi /2$.
